subject: Xtreme Ninja Martial Arts and Fitness
overview: The Medford Bytes podcast hosts spoke with Ninja and Anna Nguyen, owners of Xtreme Ninja Martial Arts and Fitness. The owners discussed their personal backgrounds, their community-focused philosophy, and the programs they offer to youth and adults.

items.title: Introductions and Local Restaurants
items.summary: Co-owners Ninja and Anna Nguyen introduced their studio and highlighted their favorite local dining spots in Medford Square.

items.title: Founding Story and Community Philosophy
items.summary: Ninja Nguyen recounted his journey through martial arts, personal adversity, and returning to Medford, explaining the studio's focus on mentorship, life skills, and family empowerment.

items.title: Studio Programs and Facility Information
items.summary: The owners detailed their multi-studio facility, introductory one-on-one sessions for children, and class offerings including self-defense, Muay Thai, kickboxing, and strength training.
